overview: A Vietnamese career-trial web app where students work through a real career challenge, tick off each step, answer quick-check questions, and get mentor-style feedback on whether the career suits them.
features: Work through a Career Trial task list with expandable step-by-step checklists
Tick off each step and watch completed tasks get marked done
Answer quick-check questions and write personal reflections
Get an assessment of how well the career suits you, with strengths and areas to improve
Chat with a mentor helper docked in the corner for advice
See a pilot pricing popup on arrival that you can dismiss
Sign in or create a student account with a matching design
